title: 3-Day App Protocol — build spec (Gate 0 contract)
description: Output of P1 DISCOVERY (web-intake compilation). Gate 0 validates .protocol/spec.json against this schema. Every provisioning item must be checked (script-verifiable) or attested (human) before Gate 0 goes green.

project.description: Project name; also the run dir name under ~/builds/<project>/.

pages.description: Every page/screen the app ships with. Anything not listed here is outside the scope fence.

entities.description: Data entities (each becomes a table with RLS in Gate 2's catalog).

roles.description: Auth roles; drives the per-identity RLS test matrix in Gate 2.

direction.description: One-line design direction (e.g. 'apple-light minimalism per ian-design-standards').

tokens.description: Design tokens (colors, type scale...) — Gate 1 lints against these.

deployTarget.description: v1 supports Vercel only (multi-stack explicitly out of scope).

scopeFence.description: Explicit NOT-in-scope list; the anti-scope-creep contract.

protectedRoutes.description: Routes that MUST deny anonymous access (401/403/redirect). Gate 3's deployed anon RLS probe fetches each one without an auth cookie; a 200 is a red gate. At least one is required so the deployed proof has something to check.

provisioning.description: Gate 0 provisioning checklist. Script-verifiable items carry checked:true/false (fill via `gate-check doctor`); human-attest items carry attested:true/false.

docker.description: Informational, NOT required. Docker was deferred 2026-08-01: Gate 2 proves RLS against the app's own provisioned Supabase project, which is stronger than a container plus a hand-written stub of Supabase's auth schema. Previously this demanded checked:true, which made Gate 0 unpassable without attesting to a daemon that `gate-check doctor` itself reports as optional — and `gate-check init` writes checked:false, so the tool's own scaffold failed its own gate. Record the real state here; never write true to get past the gate.

claudePlan.description: Human attests: Claude plan with enough headroom for the run.

supabaseRef.description: Human attests: Supabase project created, ref in hand.

vercelAccount.description: Human attests: Vercel account/team ready, project linkable.
